# Lagoon Watersports

> Lagoon Watersports offers tuition, equipment hire, and events for stand-up paddleboarding (SUP), wakeboarding, and other water sports at Hove Lagoon in Brighton.

Based at Hove Lagoon in Brighton, Lagoon Watersports is a dedicated watersports center providing instruction from beginner taster sessions to improver courses, equipment hire, and regular riding memberships across multiple disciplines. The facility features a System 2.0 cable park for wakeboarding and hosts clubs, clinics, and community events.

## Key Topics

- Hove Lagoon
- Brighton watersports
- Stand-up paddleboarding (SUP)

- [Gift Vouchers](https://www.lagoon.co.uk/gift-voucher): Purchase gift vouchers valid 2 years for Lagoon Watersports courses

## Stand-Up Paddleboarding (SUP)

- [SUP in Brighton](https://www.lagoon.co.uk/standup-paddleboard-sup): SUP tuition, lessons, hire, yoga & racing at Hove Lagoon Brighton
- [SUP Taster lesson in Brighton](https://www.lagoon.co.uk/course/sup-standup-paddleboarding/sup-taster): Introductory SUP taster lesson at Hove Lagoon with all equipment
- [SUP private 1:1 Tuition in Brighton](https://www.lagoon.co.uk/course/sup-standup-paddleboarding/sup-private-tuition): Private one-on-one SUP tuition at Hove Lagoon for beginners
- [Improvers SUP Course](https://www.lagoon.co.uk/course/sup-standup-paddleboarding/improvers-sup-brighton): Improvers SUP course to develop paddleboarding skills at Hove Lagoon
- [SUP Yoga Brighton](https://www.lagoon.co.uk/course/sup-standup-paddleboarding/sup-yoga-brighton): SUP Yoga fitness class combining paddleboarding & yoga at Hove Lagoon
- [Sup Club and Clinics at Hove Lagoon, Brighton](https://www.lagoon.co.uk/standup-paddleboard-sup/brighton-sup-clinics-and-clubs): SUP clubs and clinics including yoga training at Hove Lagoon
- [SUP hire from Hove Lagoon, Brighton](https://www.lagoon.co.uk/standup-paddleboard-sup/hire): SUP equipment hire from Hove Lagoon for experienced paddlers

## Wakeboarding

- [Wakeboarding in Brighton](https://www.lagoon.co.uk/wakeboarding): Wakeboarding lessons & sessions at System 2.0 cable park Hove Lagoon
- [Wakeboard Taster | Lagoon Watersports](https://www.lagoon.co.uk/course/wakeboard-taster): Introductory wakeboard taster course at Hove Lagoon cable system
- [Wakeboard Improvers Course](https://www.lagoon.co.uk/course/wakeboarding/wakeboard-improvers-brighton): Wakeboard improvers course with BWSW training at Hove Lagoon
- [Private Wakeboard Cable Hire](https://www.lagoon.co.uk/course/wakeboarding/private-wakeboard-cable-hire): Private wakeboard cable hire for individuals, families & groups
- [Ride the Wakeboard Cables](https://www.lagoon.co.uk/course/wakeboarding/ride-the-cables): Wakeboarding sessions at Lagoon Wake Park with 3 System 2.0 cables
- [Wakeboarding Riding and Clinics at Hove Lagoon, Brighton](https://www.lagoon.co.uk/wakeboarding/clinics): Wakeboarding clinics & training for intermediate riders at Hove Lagoon
- [Wakeboarding Regular Riding Options](https://www.lagoon.co.uk/wakeboarding/regular-riding): Wakeboarding membership, passes & club options at Hove Lagoon
